purpose: Observe internal signals before designing focalization; no SOTA or confirmatory claims
hypothesis: Fixed-geometry RBF-PIKAN exposes spatially heterogeneous activation coverage and parameter sensitivity that can be measured independently of reference solutions; whether they predict validation error remains an exploratory question.
negative_outcomes: signals unstable across checkpoints or seeds

model.family: project-specific Gaussian RBF-PIKAN inspired by FastKAN and Free-RBF-KAN

diagnostics: normalized residual by equation on held-out coordinates
Gaussian basis occupancy and effective rank
output sensitivity to edge coefficients mapped to physical coordinates
wall time by phase and peak device memory

reference_rules.burgers: exact traveling wave, operator substitution and trace tests required
reference_rules.allen_cahn: field error locked until independent BDF/space refinement reference passes
reference_rules.dfg: field error locked until independent curved-geometry P2/P1 FEM reference passes; residual and boundary diagnostics alone are not solution accuracy

frameworks.tracking: W&B offline first, private online project after scoped service approval and authentication
